from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from decimal import Decimal
import json,hashlib,re
ROOT=Path.cwd()
R31="reports/research/510300_bank_release_vintage_and_nim_definition_probe_v1"
R32="reports/research/510300_dr007_transaction_amount_source_and_prior_use_probe_v1"
OFF="reports/research/510300_official_dr007_source_v1"
OUT=ROOT/R32
def readj(p):return json.loads((ROOT/p).read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256((ROOT/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def save(n,x):
 p=OUT/n;assert not p.exists(),"已存在不覆盖"
 p.write_text(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
protocol=readj(R32+"/protocol.json")
for p in protocol["parents"]:assert sha(p["path"])==p["sha256"]
ledger=readj(R32+"/request_ledger.json");assert len(ledger)==2
for item in ledger:
 assert sha(item["raw_path"])==item["sha256"]
 assert not item["retry"]
 assert (ROOT/item["raw_path"]).stat().st_size==item["bytes"]
assert sum(x["bytes"] for x in ledger)==37392
text=(OUT/"提供方字段说明_全文.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
sample=re.search(r"DR007\.IB\s+(20200804)\s+DR007\s+([0-9.]+)\s+([0-9.]+)",text)
assert sample and "成交金额(万元)" in text and "amount" in text
old=readj("data/raw/510300_asymmetric_stress_hazard_v1_dr007_tushare_v1_0_2/repo_daily/repo_daily_DR007_IB_20200101_20201231.json")["data"]
old_rows=[dict(zip(old["fields"],v)) for v in old["items"]]
match=next(v for v in old_rows if v["trade_date"]==sample.group(1))
assert Decimal(str(match["weight"]))==Decimal(sample.group(2))
off_path=OFF+"/sources/official_dr_daily_20260928.json"
official=readj(off_path);dr=[x for x in official["records"] if x["instrmntCd"]=="DR007"]
assert len(dr)==1 and official["data"]["lastDate"]=="2026-09-28"
component=(ROOT/OFF/"sources/daily_repo_component.html").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
assert re.search(r'data-name="trdVol">成交量\(亿元\)',component)
empty=readj(R32+"/官方日报_固定20200804响应.json")
assert empty["data"]["lastDate"]=="2020-08-04" and len(empty["records"])==0
definitions={"candidate_identity":protocol["candidate_identity_frozen"],
 "provider":{"api":"repo_daily","code":"DR007.IB","repo_maturity":"DR007","value_field":"amount","unit":"万元",
 "rate_value_field":"weight","reference_url":"https://tushare.pro/document/2?doc_id=256"},
 "provider_document_example":{"date":sample.group(1),"weighted_rate_percent":sample.group(2),"amount_wan_cny":sample.group(3),
 "amount_yi_cny":str(Decimal(sample.group(3))/Decimal("10000")),
 "weight_matches_original_saved_response":True,"example_is_not_full_historical_panel":True},
 "official_saved_daily":{"date":"2026-09-28","instrument":"DR007","quantity_field":"trdVol","quantity_unit":"亿元",
 "quantity_yi_cny":dr[0]["trdVol"],"weighted_rate_percent":dr[0]["wghtdAvgRepoRate"],"mean_actual_term_days":dr[0]["avgPrd"],
 "source_path":off_path,"source_sha256":sha(off_path),
 "unit_display_path":OFF+"/sources/daily_repo_component.html","unit_display_sha256":sha(OFF+"/sources/daily_repo_component.html")},
 "conversion":"1亿元=10000万元；Tushare amount/10000为亿元。数量字段以金额单位显示，不是证券股数。",
 "cross_provider_numerical_agreement":"NOT_COMPUTED_DIFFERENT_DATES",
 "actual_mean_term_is_not_exactly_7_days":True,
 "daily_schedule_limit":"官方2200是前端时点参数，不证明历史逐日首次发布时间。旧利率输入的次日开盘合同不自动认证成交额原时钟。",
 "sample_membership_boundary":"DR为存款类机构/利率债质押样本，不是全市场R007、非银纯样本、交易所或央行操作分配量。"}
save("字段身份_单位_全部两个有限样例.json",definitions)
prior={"bounded_review_reference":R31+"/下一候选_已有用途与本地字段预览.json",
 "files_scanned_previously":readj(R31+"/下一候选_已有用途与本地字段预览.json")["searched_files"],
 "known_raw_quantity_already_saved":off_path,"already_observed_rate_reason_note":OFF+"/资金价格背后的原因与日终锚点.md",
 "raw_quantity_existing_does_not_mean_previously_fit":True,
 "new_proposed_use":"把每日同DR007成交额作为原订单/融资/价格非线性评分的条件；不同于旧价格差/单日观测。",
 "old_families":["FR007-FDR007固定价差/经验分布和完整账户已失败，不重开。","逆回购公告分配/合同到期E19不同于市场成交额。","旧DR007来源只准入weight利率，不准入amount。"],
 "new_model_increment_not_yet_run":True,"whole_repo_historical_absence_proof":False}
save("旧用途与本候选实质区别.json",prior)
gate={"study_id":protocol["study_id"],"status":"FIELD_IDENTITY_AND_AMOUNT_UNIT_CONFIRMED_FULL_DAILY_SUPPORT_NOT_ESTABLISHED",
 "provider_field_exists":True,"official_same_DR_quantity_field_exists":True,
 "original_12_provider_responses_include_amount":False,
 "official_fixed_20200804_request_records":0,
 "official_fixed_20200804_lastDate_echo_not_a_historical_value":True,
 "official_endpoint_response_window":{k:empty["data"].get(k) for k in ["startDate","endDate","lastDate"]},
 "original_full_mature_training_support":"NOT_ESTABLISHED",
 "original_daily_decision_support":"NOT_ESTABLISHED","historical_amount_first_publication_clock":"NOT_ESTABLISHED",
 "historical_amount_first_vintage":"NOT_ESTABLISHED","admitted_to_model":False,
 "provider_documentation_sample_not_a_training_dataset":True,
 "later_20260928_official_sample_not_backfilled":True,
 "no_drop_members_no_fill_zero_no_proxy":True,"new_features":0,"new_fits":0,"new_accounts":0}
save("source_gate.json",gate)
now=datetime.now(ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai")).isoformat()
status="COMPLETED_DR007_TRANSACTION_AMOUNT_IDENTITY_UNIT_AND_LIMITED_SAMPLES_FULL_PANEL_NOT_ADMITTED"
cls="PROGRESS_E32_TRUE_DR007_AMOUNT_FIELD_AND_UNIT_CONFIRMED_PUBLIC_OLD_DATE_EMPTY_RESPONSE_BOUNDARY"
summary="E32核实repo_daily的amount为万元，文档20200804 DR007.IB/DR007示例8751142万元=875.1142亿元，weight2.1144%与原保存利率相同；本地已存官方20260928 DR007的trdVol823.8757亿元、实际平均期限6.80日，字段为同一DR品种的金额。不同日期不比较数值一致。官方固定20200804请求HTTP200且lastDate回显，但records为空、窗口为2026近期，不能当历史值。2查询/2新直链/37392字节，字段真实/单位接受，完整原成熟池及金额公开时钟/版本仍未建立；0带凭据API/拟合/标签/账户/源码，夏普NOT_COMPUTED、完整目标未达。"
result={"study_id":protocol["study_id"],"experiment_id":"E32","status":status,"completed_at":now,"classification":cls,
 "summary":summary,"source_gate":R32+"/source_gate.json","facts_report":R32+"/DR007成交额身份与历史支持_研究结论.md",
 "directory_queries_used":2,"new_unique_direct_source_urls":2,"new_direct_source_requests":2,
 "new_raw_source_objects":2,"new_download_bytes":37392,"provider_authenticated_api_calls":0,
 "candidate_amount_field_exists":True,"original_full_training_support":"NOT_ESTABLISHED",
 "new_fits":0,"new_training_labels":0,"new_full_accounts":0,"source_code_edits":0,"net_sharpe":"NOT_COMPUTED",
 "goal_achieved":False,"current_view":"NO_VIEW","position":"UNSET","orders_authorized":False,"new_prospective_forecasts_enabled":False,
 "previous_goal_turn_classification":protocol["previous_goal_turn_classification"],"consecutive_blocked_goal_turns":0,
 "stop_reason":"本来源问题已回答；官方旧日期空响应不重试或修改查询日营救；仅真正取得同身份完整成交额另注册后续。"}
save("result.json",result)
report=f"""# E32：DR007成交额确实存在，完整历史尚未准入

结论：候选字段真实存在，数量与利率属于同一DR007统计品种，但当前保存数据尚不能支持原完整训练池。{status}。净夏普未计算，完整目标未达。

提供方[repo_daily官方文档](https://tushare.pro/document/2?doc_id=256)明确amount是成交金额，单位万元。文档固定2020-08-04样例含DR007.IB、DR007、加权利率2.1144%、成交金额8,751,142万元（875.1142亿元）。该日利率与旧保存响应2.1144%相同，支持字段/代码对应；文档示例不是完整历史数据。

本地早已保存的官方2026-09-28日报中，DR007的trdVol为823.8757，组件明确单位亿元；利率1.3911%，实际平均期限6.80日。此前该原件用于利率和原因观察，没有把每日数量加入本评分。名义DR007不等于所有成交恰好7日，不等于全市场R007、非银或央行操作。两日期不同，未计算提供方数值一致性。

按独立文档唯一示例日2020-08-04向原已确认官方日报接口请求，HTTP200，lastDate也回显2020-08-04，但records为空，startDate/endDate为2026-09-18/2026-10-01。没有历史数值，不能据日期回显宣称可下载该日、将空量记0或用近期值代替。固定失败保留，不换日重试营救。

已有12个Tushare原响应只包含代码/日期/期限/weight，没有amount。候选源门确认字段和单位，完整历史金额、所有原成熟成员与决定日支持仍NOT_ESTABLISHED；原逐日公布时钟及首版尚未认证。官方2200参数不是历史首次公开证明，旧利率合同不自动赋予新数量字段准入。

经济假设是：相近利率下，数量状态或许能区别融资活跃与缩量环境；仍需订单、融资、价格条件共同判断，不预设成交量增就利好，也不把一元相关叫因果。旧FR-FDR固定失败、逆回购公告用途、E26—E31裁决均保持。

2次来源查询、2新唯一直链、2原件37,392字节，带凭据API、新增拟合/标签/账户/源码均为0。首个搜索结果保存因PowerShell外部Unicode引号失败，改用文件补丁保存原响应；没有重复网络请求。没有运行无关全仓测试。当前NO_VIEW，仓位UNSET。

证据：[固定协议](protocol.json)、[字段与两样例](字段身份_单位_全部两个有限样例.json)、[用途区别](旧用途与本候选实质区别.json)、[请求账本](request_ledger.json)、[来源门](source_gate.json)、[完整结果](result.json)。
"""
(OUT/"DR007成交额身份与历史支持_研究结论.md").write_text(report,encoding="utf-8")
save("必要核对.json",{"frozen_13_parents_unchanged":True,"2_raw_objects_match_hash_size":True,
 "provider_example_weight_equals_saved_source":True,"unit_conversion_exact":True,
 "official_old_date_empty_not_zero":True,"official_lastDate_echo_not_a_value":True,
 "different_dates_not_numerically_compared":True,"no_original_source_or_code_overwrite":True,
 "new_fits":0,"new_accounts":0,"goal_achieved":False})
print(json.dumps({"实验":"E32完成","字段":"amount万元/官方trdVol亿元","官方旧样例":"空响应，拒绝当数值","全训练准入":"未建立","新拟合":0},ensure_ascii=False))
